title: Light Nutty American Corn Casserole
description: A nostalgic American dish featuring a blend of corn, chimichurri sauce, and bonito flakes, all in a Jain-friendly recipe, baked to perfection in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the thawed corn kernels, chimichurri sauce, and bonito flakes, stirring until well combined.
In a small skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and toast the chopped almonds until lightly browned.
Add the toasted almonds, salt, and black pepper to the corn mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a terracotta dish and top with grated vegan cheddar if using.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned and the casserole is heated through.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with additional toasted almonds if desired.
